Plot linked Area-Restricted Phase (ARP) clusters

Source: R/draw.linked.clusters.R
draw.linked.clusters.Rd

Generates a spatial plot of Area-Restricted Phase (ARP) clusters and the movement links between them. It visualizes ARPs as convex hulls, highlights ARP points, and draws the network edges connecting them.

Usage

draw.linked.clusters(data, ids = NULL, grid_spacing = NULL, id.col = "ID")

Arguments

data

An object of class disperseR containing movement data with ARP classifications.

ids

Character vector. A selection of individual IDs to plot. If NULL (default), plots all individuals.

grid_spacing

Numeric. Spacing for background reference grid lines. If NULL (default), no grid lines are drawn.

id.col

Character. Name of the column containing individual identifiers. Default is "ID".

Value

A ggplot object showing the spatial distribution and network of ARPs.

Examples

eps <- get.epsilon(sim_states)
#> Computing a global threshold using all data combined.
arp <- get.arp(sim_states, epsilon = eps, delta.days = 2, pct.state1 = 0.2)
linked <- link.arp(arp, thres = 24 * 3600)
draw.linked.clusters(linked)

draw.linked.clusters(linked, ids = "M01", grid_spacing = 5000)
